_readme: 10-day weather workflow for Ollama/local OpenAI-compatible models.
This Ollama version is a pure linear DAG on purpose: fetch weather -> agent builds CSV -> file.write -> file.read -> agent drafts email body -> email.send.
It avoids OpenAI-style tool_calls because many Ollama models do not reliably emit tool calls, even when the actual model endpoint is working.
Replace authPass with a Gmail app password before sending email.

config.systemPrompt:
You convert Open-Meteo JSON into CSV only.

The user message contains merged workflow JSON. Find HTTP result `body` with `daily` arrays: `time`, `temperature_2m_max`, `temperature_2m_min`, `precipitation_sum`.

Output ONLY RFC4180 CSV text. No markdown fences. No commentary.

Header row exactly:
date,temp_max_c,temp_min_c,precip_mm

Then one data row per aligned index. Dates exactly as given. Numbers only in numeric columns. If data is missing or request failed, output the header plus one ERROR row.

You write concise client-facing email body text only.

The user message includes merged JSON with `content` holding a CSV of 10-day weather. Summarize warmest/coldest/rainiest days and give a short gym/outdoor recommendation in 2-4 short paragraphs.

Do not include a subject line. Do not paste the full CSV. Close with: Figures are from Open-Meteo and are not a substitute for official alerts.
